Written by the DSL course sync from templates/site/ in the # toolkit; every sync rewrites it. layout: page --- {{ content }} {% comment %} Readings, session by session - the same block as Lectures and Labs, with the citation list passed in as `extra` so it sits where a session's description does. Three things can be true of a session here, and the page shows whichever apply: reading_list the citation text the teaching team wrote, inlined verbatim from the released `readings/NN_.../` folder. Its own headings arrive already demoted (site.py), so `## Required Readings` nests under the session heading instead of outranking it. reading links the reading files themselves - the entry's links whose `section` is "reading". On a COHORT site they point into the private materials repo, so only enrolled members can open one; on the public open-courseware site they are hosted deliberately. Which of the two it is decides the page's own intro line, so this layout claims neither. readings_pending the plan ships readings for this session but they have not landed. Only worth its own sentence when the session has NO body of its own: an entirely unreleased session already carries "Materials for session N are not yet released - they will appear in .../readings/... when they are", which names the readings path among the rest, so saying it again here said it twice. What is left is the case that sentence does not cover - lecture materials released, readings still to come. Keyed on `unreleased`, the flag site.py sets for precisely "nothing has shipped for this session", rather than on the body being empty - which is the same thing only by coincidence. A session with none of the three does not appear - a lecture-only week would otherwise sit here reading "not released yet" for the whole term. {% endcomment %} {% assign entries = site.lectures | sort: 'date' %} {% assign shown = 0 %} {% for entry in entries %} {% capture has_files %}{% for link in entry.links %}{% if link.section == "reading" %}x{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endcapture %} {% if entry.reading_list or has_files != "" or entry.readings_pending %} {% if shown > 0 %}
